sloka: वृक्षशैलमहावर्षं विसृजन्तः प्लवङ्गमाः।शत्रूणां कदनं चक्रुर्नेदुश्च विविधैः स्वरैः ।। ६.८२.१५ ।।
transliteration: vṛkṣaśailamahāvarṣaṁ visṛjantaḥ plavaṅgamāḥ।śatrūṇāṁ kadanaṁ cakrurneduśca vividhaiḥ svaraiḥ ।। 6.82.15 ।।

translations.english: Night rangers of dreadful appearance beaten up with trees by most fierce Vanaras, fell on the battlefield and struck one another.
